source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Outline the safety deficiencies.
3. Specify regulatory non-compliance.
4. Document witness statements.
5. Record equipment malfunctions.
6. Summarize witness interviews.
7. Photograph evidence.
8. Notate unsafe practices.
9. Provide a timeline of events.
10. Propose corrective actions.
11. Include auditor comments.
12. Add supporting documents.
13. List out all violations categorized by severity.
14. Describe the immediate impact of violations on operations.
15. Outline long-term consequences of not rectifying the issues.
16. Detail any injuries or near-misses.
17. Recommend follow-up actions and deadlines.
18. Involve key personnel in the review of the report.
19. Validate findings with data and facts.
20. Ensure comprehensive documentation of all discussion points.
21. File the report in the appropriate place for future reference or legal requirements.
22. Communicate results and actions required to all relevant parties.
23. Ensure a copy
